text: In this chapter I shall explain to you how the Mutakallemim prove the Unity of God. They contend that the Maker and Creator of the Universe, the existence of whom is testified by all nature, is One. Two propositions are employed by them in demonstrating the Unity of God, viz., two deities or Edition: current; Page: [139] more would neutralize each other, and if several deities existed they would be distinguished from each other by a specific difference.
